\begin{proof}
Let $\bar a,\bar b,\bar c\in\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z$, represented by $a,b,c\in\mathbb Z$. Then
\[
\begin{aligned}
(\bar a+\bar b)+\bar c
&=\overline{a+b}+\bar c\\
&=\overline{(a+b)+c}\\
&=\overline{a+(b+c)}\\
&=\bar a+\overline{b+c}\\
&=\bar a+(\bar b+\bar c),
\end{aligned}
\]
by associativity of integer addition. Hence addition in $\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z$ is associative.
\end{proof}
